verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a delegate-review-merge workflow ('Delegate a task, review the diff, and merge from the App or your terminal'), directly matching the story, plus tiered autonomy controls that gate what runs without confirmation. Missing for 10: no detailed walkthrough of the diff-review UI itself, no explicit mention of blocking PR creation until approval, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the review step actually working as described.
